Calculate clustering metrics across gene-selection strategies

Source: R/clustering_runner.R
calculate_gene_selection_metrics.Rd

Calculate ARI, NMI, HOM, COM, spatial ASW, and Overall clustering agreement for each gene-selection strategy.

Usage

calculate_gene_selection_metrics(
  banksy_list,
  ground_truth_col = "layer_guess",
  cluster_col = "banksy_cluster",
  asw_max_cells = 3000,
  seed = 123
)

Arguments

banksy_list

Output from run_banksy_gene_selection().

ground_truth_col

Ground-truth annotation column.

cluster_col

Predicted cluster column.

asw_max_cells

Maximum cells used for spatial ASW.

seed

Random seed.

Value

Data frame containing clustering metrics and gene sets. #' @examples data(norm_example)

banksy_genes <- run_banksy_gene_selection( norm_list = norm_example, methods = names(norm_example), gene_selection = "all", assay_name = "logcounts", k_geom = 15, lambda = 0.8, resolution = 0.2, seed = 123 )

metrics_genes <- calculate_gene_selection_metrics( banksy_list = banksy_genes, ground_truth_col = "layer_guess" )

Examples

data(norm_example)

banksy_results <- run_banksy_individual(
  norm_list = norm_example,
  methods = names(norm_example),
  assay_name = "logcounts",
  cluster_col = "banksy_cluster",
  k_geom = 15,
  lambda = 0.8,
  resolution = 0.2,
  seed = 123
)
